content: An AI agent is an assistant configured for a task. Your role determines whether you can use its chat, add files to its Knowledge base or view saved results in Chat outputs.

comment.text: Body of the first AI Agents onboarding tour step, anchored on the AI agents item in the left sidebar; variant for non-admin users (admins see AgentWhatIs). Knowledge base and Chat outputs are UI section names.
